pluss::subsp::stats::ts::SarimaOptions¶

Options of ts::Sarima::fit_mle: the orders in the usual seasonal letters.

SarimaOptions is ArimaOptions spelled with (p, d, q)(P, D, Q)s.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

p, d, q

std::int64_t

1, 0, 0

Regular autoregressive, differencing and moving-average orders.

P, D, Q

std::int64_t

0, 0, 0

Seasonal autoregressive, differencing and moving-average orders.

s

std::int64_t

0

The season length; it must exceed 1 when P, D or Q is nonzero.

demean

bool

true

Subtract the sample mean first.

intercept0, ar0, ma0, sar0, sma0, beta0

double / vectors

0 / empty

Starting values.

variance_floor, stationarity_margin, finite_diff_eps

double

1e-12, 1e-6, 1e-5

As in ArimaOptions.

max_iterations, max_evaluations, simplex_delta

—

800, 6000, 0.05

Search limits, as in ArimaOptions.

exact_likelihood

bool

true

Exact (Kalman) or conditional likelihood, as in ArimaOptions.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
